title: YouTube Channel Scraper — Extract Analytics & Video Data
description: Scrape YouTube channels and their latest videos for analytics data. Accepts channel URLs, handles (@name), or search keywords.

channelUrls.title: Channel URLs
channelUrls.description: List of YouTube channel URLs or handles to scrape (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd or @mkbhd)
channelUrls.sectionDescription: Provide YouTube channel URLs or handles. Both full URLs and @handles are accepted.

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search YouTube for channels. Results will be scraped automatically.
searchKeywords.sectionDescription: Optional: search YouTube for channels by keyword.

maxChannels.title: Max Channels from Search
maxChannels.description: Maximum number of channels to scrape from each search keyword

maxVideosPerChannel.title: Max Videos Per Channel
maxVideosPerChannel.description: Number of latest videos to scrape per channel (max 100)

includeShorts.title: Include Shorts
includeShorts.description: Whether to include YouTube Shorts in video scraping

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the crawler. Datacenter proxies work well for YouTube.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Configure proxies to avoid rate limiting.
